crossRefs.note: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to…
Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after…
Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant…
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

translations.web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
translations.bsb: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.
translations.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
translations.asv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: Remove thy foot from evil.
